hook: Nobody remembers the exit; he remembers the five near-death moments minute by minute
why: Founder war story from the Justin.tv/Twitch co-founder: famous name, counter-intuitive payoff (the money day is a blur, the crises are vivid), ends on a gym-PR analogy everyone gets.

hook: If nothing in your life is uncomfortable, you're very easy to replace
why: Mildly provocative jab at cushy big-tech jobs (free laundry, comfy desks) that ends on a quotable punchline; invites debate in the comments.

hook: Ice cream is type one fun. Climbing a mountain is type two fun.
why: Teaches a sticky named concept in under a minute with everyday examples; shareable beyond startup audiences; ends on a laugh.

hook: I want to present a possibly triggering thought
why: Opens with a built-in curiosity hook, then a relatable school memory: the regular class wasn't more fun, it was boring. Reframes ambition as needing challenge.

hook: 'I got into YC, I can be comfortable.' Bad news: you're not going to make it.
why: Insider tough-love from YC partners about what they told every batch; short, punchy, with laughs.

hook: How long will you last if every day feels like suffering?
why: A clear, actionable argument (enjoying hard work means you outlast competitors) that lands on a famous YC saying.

hook: Plants turn sunlight into energy. Great founders turn discomfort into motivation.
why: Memorable analogy plus a sharp closer: the hardest competitor is the one having a great time.

hook: But they can't kill half the people
why: Funny boot-camp comparison that turns into a responsible message (push hard, but look after yourself); balances the hustle clips.

hook: 'It'll get easy after the Series B.' It doesn't.
why: Busts a common founder myth with a vivid image (getting pummeled by the rock); relatable to anyone grinding toward a milestone.

hook: The hidden advantage of the founders you admire, and anyone can grab it
why: The episode's own cold open: pure curiosity gap with the reveal ('type two fun') at the end. Works as a teaser that drives viewers to the full episode.
